schedule_proxy.description: Exploratory canonical A/C-T schedule proxy because the current normalized cohort records treatment context but not patient-level administration events.

interpretation: Exploratory real-cohort evaluation, not a locked confirmatory analysis.
The treatment schedule is a cohort-level A/C-T proxy rather than patient-specific administration history.
No likelihood, threshold, prior, or schedule decision may be declared final from this run.
Final outcome volume is used only for evaluation after inference.
